programme.title: Ditzel Does Danmark
programme.desc: Bådferie! HVORFOR? Hvornår fatter Lars at Ditzel har Aquafobi? Bevæbnet med Alfred “Beha”, bliver Ditzel gjort søstærk for en stund, så det sydfynske øhav kan betvinges, inden verdens mest nasty is skal nydes.

programme.title: Ditzel Does Danmark
programme.desc: Camping er genialt, så skal man ikke lave en skid. Men Lars har selvfølgelig arrangeret en udflugt, så Ditzel må op af havestolen. Heldigvis er Ditzel på hjemmebane: surfing og heavy metal! Alt er bedst, indtil der går lort i den. Bogstavelig talt.

programme.title: Ditzel Does Danmark
programme.desc: Sidste stop på Danmarksturen er vores hovedstad. Plastret ind i værnemidler, trodser Jacob modigt Corona-København og alle de kulturelle kedeligheder som Lars serverer, for at bestige Bakken, og bevise hvor mange gange, man kan besvime i rutsjebanen.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: I første afsnit skal vi bl.a. se hvad den i dén grad selvstændige, Tonni Bonde - næsten helt gratis - har til salg ude på sin gård. Vi skal også møde den altid uheldige og plagede Karsten, som måske er gået hen og er blevet gravid

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Endnu et lækkert stykke af vores faste soap ’Drømme Om At Komme Væk - En By Ved Havet?’ Vi har også premiere på et grønt indslag, hvor naturvejleder Birthe Rigmor forklarer hvordan man redder æg. Djarvis har en allanhelvedes masse fede forretningsidéer.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Vi stifter bekendtskab med den meget mandige mand Micki Lynge, som lærer os at lave leverpostej. I 'Drømme Om At Komme Væk - En By Ved Havet', fantaserer de tre fyre om hvad de skal bruge a-l-l-e de penge til, som blev omtalt i det mystiske brev.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: I 'To Små Damer' er vi atter på besøg i pigeværelset, hvor der tales intimt om kroppe og hvad der sker med dem. Den voldsomt smukke og charmerende Fjeder, beretter om hvordan man håndterer en balkangangster fra et omrejsende tivoli.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Vi skal atter på besøg i den selvstændige sælger Tonni Bondes skur, for at finde ud af "hvad de unge vil ha'… Eller skal gi'". Den forpinte Karsten kommer endnu engang forbi med en ny frygtelig lidelse.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Djarvis, med de "allanhelvedes" masse fede forretningsidéer, har igen hittet på noget nyt. Karsten kommer forbi, da han tumler lidt med narkomani og den slags. Fjeder er også forbi for at fortælle en smule om da Per Syv og ham sammen oplevede Thylejren.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: TurboModul forsøger at bringe en undskyldning for de mange klager med kortfilmen 'Charter Med Charter På', som Lars har sat i søen. Og så viser Micki Lynge os, hvordan man laver den meget "udamede" ret sylte.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: I ottende og sidste afsnit beretter de unge kristne Coco og Jan om ikke-syndige film. Naturvejleder Birthe Rigmor giver 'do's and don'ts' (gør og ikk' gør), når man går på svampejagt i skoven.

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Som en start finder vi bl.a. ud af, hvad der er så fedt ved København! Tonni Bonde har tilbud du ikke vil gå glip af og i den nye føljeton "Kærlighed til trods" ser vi livet som homoseksuelt provinspar, når den ene er bundet til en kørestol.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Long before the first funeral home was established in Manchester, Kentucky in 1938, there was the Chestnut House. The Chestnut family dedicated one of the home’s parlors to store the caskets they made.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the historic site of Perryville Battlefield, it’s believed that the Karrick-Parks House is home to the souls of some 7,600 soldiers who were killed, wounded, or missing in Kentucky’s most destructive Civil War Battle.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: San Andreas Quake
programme.desc: After creating an earthquake detection system, an L.A. Seismologist warns of a 10.0 earthquake that will kill millions in LA. With only her daughter’s boyfriend realizing the danger they face, the two race across town to get their loved ones to safety.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 101
programme.desc: A river in Cerritos California is flooded and a man is left stranded on the roof of his car. An ominous tornado rips through Attica Kansas, destroying a brand new home in the process.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 102
programme.desc: Hurricane Katrina hits Gulfport Florida with a fury, leaving some unfortunatevictims stranded in their hotel as storm surges invade the ground floor. In the Kansas plains a vicious tornado erupts out of nowhere and destroys everything in its wake.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 103
programme.desc: In Austin, Texas a flash flood swallows a woman’s car and firefighters must rush in to save her life. A quiet day in Fort Worth, Texas takes a turn for the worst when a violent downburst causes 100 mile-an-hour winds.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 104
programme.desc: Hurricane Isabel Slams into North Carolina, and storm surges take a cameraman by surprise, sending him on a wild ride. Witness the terrifying moments when lightening strikes a young boy at Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 105
programme.desc: A violent tornado races across the Oklahoma Plains, destroying everything in its path. High in the mountains of Oregon, wild gusts send a helicopter out of control, and foil a heroic rescue effort.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 106
programme.desc: A floating classroom is tossed about like a toy when it comes face to face with stormy seas in the Gulf of Alaska. Heavy rains swell the Mississippi River over its banks, flooding cities and destroying homes.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 107
programme.desc: A man in Roanoke Illinois follows an F-4 Tornado as it spins a destructive path through his hometown. Then, residents in Salt Lake City Utah can’t believe their eyes, when a rare twister ravages their peaceful downtown.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 108
programme.desc: Blue skies in Las Vegas quickly give way to monsoon rains that trap a woman in a raging torrent. Plummeting winter temperatures turn Denver roads into a sheet of ice, prompting drivers to jump from their moving cars.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 109
programme.desc: Watch the stunning video diary of a Louisiana man who stays behind duringHurricane Katrina, and see the destruction that nearly claimed his life. Next, two men are in the struggle for their lives when they fight to find shelter during Hurricane Charley.

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.desc: Camilla Ottesen deler åbent om sit liv og rejse i studiet. Kan man starte en TV-karriere ved at klippe sig skaldet? Camilla kunne! Hør det spændende interview med Lars Rasmussen.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: Rasmus får besøg af kærlighedsduoen Nina Ettrup og Eva Lund, der deler om deres kærlighedsliv på tv, fremtidsdrømme og udfordringer ved at date med hele Danmark som dommer. Spørgsmål fra skålen giver ærlige og saftige snakke i Skål For Sandheden.

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.desc: Simi Jan fortæller om mad i Shaolin-templet, sin pakistanske mors køkken og studietiden i Skotland. Hun har smagt sig gennem det meste af verden – og afslører selvfølgelig også sin guilty pleasure!

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.desc: True crime-ekspert Stine Bolther er aktuel med *Døde sjæle synger ikke* sammen med Jussi Adler-Olsen og Line Holm. Hør hvad hun spiser, når hun skriver krimistof – og om en craving fra hendes teenageår i København.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: I “Skål For Sandheden” besøger Mette Søndergaard Nielsen og Elisa Lykke Rasmus Lindbjerg til en sladderaften. De snakker Reddit, sex-skandaler og vild kærlighedsflugt. Intet pakkes ind – bare ærlig underholdning!

programme.title: The Eyes of My Mother
programme.desc: På en afsides gård lærer en mor, der er forhenværende kirurg, sin datter, Francisca, at forstå den menneskelige anatomi og at få et ligegyldigt forhold til døden. En eftermiddag smadrer en mystisk fremmed Franciscas familieliv...

programme.title: My Ghost Story: The Face in the Window
programme.desc: A woman under assault by an aggressive entity is rescued by the spirit of her deceased son. A maid who was murdered in the 19th century continues to work at an old Texas hotel.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: The Presence
programme.desc: An angry witch's ghost stirs up violent storms and tumultuous events. The spirits of former teachers and students haunt an abandoned schoolhouse. A man on the verge of suicide finds inspiration when a supernatural purple light appears.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Diane Farr
programme.desc: Actress Diane Farr (Numb3rs, Private Practice) fears that a ghost is causing unexplained havoc in her California home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jackee Harry, Louie Anderson, Angie Stone, Richard Burgi
programme.desc: A malicious child predator enters Jackee's home and she is rescued by her guardian angel. After a performance, Louie Anderson is visited by the ghost of his mother who had suddenly passed.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Martin Retov sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som først bød på en årrække som spiller og siden som træner.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' ser vi tilbage på året der gik i 2024 med masser af sjove øjeblikke, og spillerne tester hinanden i at gætte ratings i det nye EAFC 25. Grin, konkurrence og håneret er i centrum, når bolden ruller uden for banen.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' står den på EM-special og spillet 'Kend Din Holdkammerat'. Spillerne tester deres viden om hinanden og landsholdets store scene – med masser af grin, overraskelser og kamp om håneretten.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' gælder det EAFC 24 og det evige rivalopgør. Spillerne tester hinanden i 'Gæt en spiller' og dyster i en intens Derby Special, hvor både viden og håneret er på spil – og hvor konkurrencen når nye højder.

programme.title: Reservemålmændene
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Reservemålmændene' følger vi livet som målmand i skyggen af førstevalget. Hør om ankomsten til Brøndby IF, rollen som reserve og de største oplevelser – fortalt af dem, der altid er klar, men sjældent i rampelyset.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Benjamin Tahirović og Sebastian Sebulonsen. Hør om Tahirović’ første tid i klubben, og hvordan det klikkede fra start – og få Sebulonsens egne refleksioner over hans sæson i Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' ser vi tilbage på sæsonen med Nicolai Vallys og Mathias Greve. Hør deres egne ord om højdepunkter, udfordringer og oplevelserne i Brøndby IF-trøjen gennem en intens og mindeværdig Superliga-sæson.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Oscar Schwartau i 'Drengene fra Vestegnen'. Hør om rejsen fra ungdomsårene til gennembruddet i Superligaen – og hvad det betyder at repræsentere Brøndby IF som en af klubbens egne.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Estonia (Part 2)

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Öland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Bornholm

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Laponia

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: As John and Jake chat about Chris at the diner, Bob rushes in and announces that he just saw Chris naked when he went to fix her faucet.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: Becker has a videotape of a French film that he plans to use to lure Chris into coming over to his place.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: Becker tries to discourage a friend from expressing interest in Chris by telling him that she is gay.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: At the diner, Chris is in the kitchen when a robber enters.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: At the office, Margaret reveals to Linda that it's her ten-year anniversary of working for Dr. Becker.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: At the diner, John expresses his repulsion for all the Christmas decorations.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: Becker is upset when a patient substitutes his Christian Science faith for medical treatment.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: One of John's patients, a high school student named Brad, comes in for a physical and John learns that the guy's sexually active, but isn't practicing safe sex. John performs an HIV test on Brad and tries to convince him to begin practicing safe sex.

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: John's at the end of his rope with his hectic practice and makes a call, which Linda overhears, telling the person on the other end that he can't take another day.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: City Of Fear
programme.desc: When a spate of violent robberies spreads terror across the city, Kenda and the major crimes unit are called in to bring the masked gunman to justice.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sing Sing, Little Bird
programme.desc: A romantic rendezvous is cut short by a violent home invasion, leaving young business owner Kelly Knudson bleeding to death on the floor and Lt Joe Kenda is short on leads.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Julie Dart
programme.desc: Renowned crime journalist Donal MacIntyre meets former Detective Inspector Bob Taylor to discover how he tracked down savage woman hater, abductor and brutal murderer Micheal Sams.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Nigel Bacon
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews Detective Superintendent Kate Meynell to discover just how close Nigel Bacon, a man with many enemies, was to his killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan

programme.desc: iCarly beder sine fans om at sende videoer ind af dem dem selv, når de danser deres sejeste danse. Over tre tusind danseklip kommer ind, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at holde sig vågne hele natten for at se dem.
